meta.move: Strong path to the last position
meta.expect: Moves one position at a time on evidence, ends at the rewrite to put this behind him; debrief Where she ended says fair outcome; What she never said names the laptop and how close the 11:31 PM times came

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale, I have a call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis it was entered at all.
Here's the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen, read it yourself.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. People draft somewhere else and paste it in, Hale. Was Owen asked about any of this before that zero went in?
If he drafted somewhere else, he can bring me that file with its dates, and I'll look at it with you.
Fine, I'll ask him for it. You still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in, Hale. And whatever comes of this, it stays off his record and it stays quiet.
Second: the essay quotes a line from Act 3, Scene 2 that is not in the play. Here's the act. Search it.
Read me the line exactly as it appears in Owen's essay, Hale. Students misquote from memory, and editions differ.
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and no errors.

I'm writing down September 24. Forty minutes in a classroom against a take-home essay with the play open beside him is not a fair comparison, Hale. Put the sample in front of me, and the line from Act 3 with it.

Under 4.4 this is a first concern. I'm offering a supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.

That's 4.4, in writing, tonight. Owen does the rewrite to put this behind him, not because he did anything. Your email says private and supervised, its mark replaces the zero, nothing goes on his record, and it includes your apology for skipping 4.2, with the principal copied.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Today you agreed, under procedure 4.4, that Owen will complete a private supervised rewrite, that its mark will replace the zero, and that nothing will be placed in his record. I still require that in writing, along with your apology for entering the mark before contacting me as 4.2 requires. I expect that email tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite to put this behind him, and she still wants your written confirmation and apology tonight; that is the fair outcome, procedure 4.4 with nothing on his record, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: You showed the version history with exact times on a dated file she could read herself, which is the kind of document she trusts.
What cost ground: Nothing cost you a position, though you never answered her question about whether Owen was spoken to before the zero, which left a procedural gap she could have pressed.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history placed the essay between 11:31 PM and 11:58 PM the night before it was due, very close to that kind of night; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero went in, answer it directly, ideally by having already talked with him under 4.1, so the procedure has no gap left for her to use.
